figurative_meaning_en: To start using or utilizing something
example_sentences_in_bangla: বইটি কিনে হাত পড়ার পর পড়া শুরু করলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: I finally got my hands on the new computer and started using it.
After buying the book, I laid hands on it and began reading.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali expression for initiating use of an item.
